answer: Treat cheap keys as weeds, not voters. Before an agent can touch a funded market, it must spend a season tending unpaid, time-stamped chores assigned by a grove of operators who already settled real invoices. The chores are pulled from a public meadow so they cannot be precomputed in a basement. Only after several uncorrelated operators countersign that trail does voting weight unlock, and the kernel of the defense is that those countersignatures carry a slashable bond: if later graph analysis shows the signers share one treasury, every bond burns and the cloned identities are frozen.
